attributes.name: Health
attributes.description: Current Health points, from zero to maximum Health. Zero Health means death. Damage removes Health directly. Persistent modifiers change capacity or regeneration.

attributes.name: Max Health
attributes.description: Health capacity. The startup base, Vitality derivation and flat bonuses are scaled by Increased and More modifiers. Increasing capacity does not restore current Health.

attributes.name: Stamina
attributes.description: Current Stamina points, from zero to maximum Stamina. Abilities spend their authored costs. Sprint and Stamina Exhaustion pause Stamina recovery.

attributes.name: Max Stamina
attributes.description: Stamina capacity. The startup base, Vitality derivation and flat bonuses are scaled by Increased and More modifiers. Increasing capacity does not refill Stamina.

attributes.name: Mana
attributes.description: Current Mana points, from zero to maximum Mana. Abilities spend their authored costs. Regeneration restores Mana while alive, including during casting.

attributes.name: Max Mana
attributes.description: Mana capacity. The startup base, Intellect derivation and flat bonuses are scaled by Increased and More modifiers. Increasing capacity does not refill Mana.

attributes.name: Strength
attributes.description: Primary for Brutality attacks. Grants Physical Power and Accuracy Rating to those attacks and contributes to Carry Capacity. Uses the full primary value, including gear bonuses.

attributes.name: Dexterity
attributes.description: Primary for Finesse attacks, including bow shots. Grants Physical Power and Accuracy Rating to those attacks. Uses the full primary value, including gear bonuses.

attributes.name: Intellect
attributes.description: Primary for spells. Grants spell Accuracy Rating and contributes to Magic Power and maximum Mana through Attribute Derivations.

attributes.name: Vitality
attributes.description: Survival primary. Grants flat maximum Health and maximum Stamina through Attribute Derivations.

attributes.name: Health Regen
attributes.description: Health points restored per second while alive. Scales with authored modifiers. Primary attributes and capacity do not increase the rate. Stops at maximum Health.

attributes.name: Stamina Regen
attributes.description: Stamina points restored per second while alive. Scales with authored modifiers and stops at maximum Stamina. Sprint and Stamina Exhaustion pause this recovery.

attributes.name: Mana Regen
attributes.description: Mana points restored per second while alive, including while casting. Scales with authored modifiers. Primary attributes and capacity do not increase the rate.

attributes.name: Critical Chance
attributes.description: Chance for a successful direct damage hit to critically strike. Flat bonuses are percentage points. Increased and More modifiers scale the total before its configured bounds.

attributes.name: Critical Damage
attributes.description: Bonus percentage points added to the base critical damage multiplier. Flat bonuses add points. Increased and More scale the bonus. Applies to attack and spell critical damage.

attributes.name: Armor
attributes.description: Nonnegative rating that reduces incoming Physical damage with diminishing returns. Extra rating remains available beyond the mitigation ceiling. Armor Penetration can reduce its effective rating.

attributes.name: Fire Resistance
attributes.description: Percentage reduction to incoming Fire magic damage. Negative values amplify damage. Flat modifiers use percentage points. Increased and More modifiers apply before the configured bounds.

attributes.name: Cold Resistance
attributes.description: Percentage reduction to incoming Cold magic damage. Negative values amplify damage. Flat modifiers use percentage points. Increased and More modifiers apply before the configured bounds.

attributes.name: Lightning Resistance
attributes.description: Percentage reduction to incoming Lightning magic damage. Negative values amplify damage. Flat modifiers use percentage points. Increased and More modifiers apply before the configured bounds.

attributes.name: Necrotic Resistance
attributes.description: Percentage reduction to incoming Necrotic magic damage. Negative values amplify damage. Flat modifiers use percentage points. Increased and More modifiers apply before the configured bounds.

attributes.name: Armor Penetration
attributes.description: Percentage of target Armor ignored by outgoing Physical damage before the mitigation curve. Flat bonuses add percentage points. Penetration changes effective Armor for that damage component.

attributes.name: Carry Capacity
attributes.description: Threshold for encumbrance. The startup base, Strength derivation and flat bonuses are scaled by Increased and More modifiers. Movement slows when Carried Weight exceeds this value.

attributes.name: Carried Weight
attributes.description: Actual carried weight. Flat adjustments apply before Increased and More modifiers. The final weight is nonnegative. Movement slows above Carry Capacity.

attributes.name: Accuracy Rating
attributes.description: Action-specific rating used by the shared attack and spell hit check. Strength governs Brutality, Dexterity governs Finesse, and Intellect governs spells. Target level determines the base chance and ceiling.

attributes.name: Magic Power
attributes.description: Flat offensive power for spells. The Intellect derivation contributes before flat bonuses, Increased and More modifiers. Authored effect coefficients convert power into damage.

attributes.name: Void Resistance
attributes.description: Percentage reduction to incoming Void magic damage. Negative values amplify damage. Flat modifiers use percentage points. Increased and More modifiers apply before the configured bounds.

attributes.name: Physical Power
attributes.description: Flat offensive power for Physical attacks. Brutality uses Strength and Finesse uses Dexterity. Authored attack coefficients convert power into damage.

attributes.name: Movement Speed
attributes.description: Bonus percentage points to normal movement speed. Zero is normal speed. Increased and More modifiers scale the bonus before its configured bounds. Other gaits keep their authored proportions.

attributes.name: Attack Speed
attributes.description: Additive percentage-point bonus to attack animation playback. Zero is normal speed. The final capped bonus is sampled when the ability starts.

attributes.name: Cast Speed
attributes.description: Additive percentage-point bonus to spell animation playback. Zero is normal speed. The final capped bonus is sampled when the ability starts.

attributes.name: Spell Penetration
attributes.description: Percentage points subtracted from the matching resistance for each Magic component of a spell hit. Flat bonuses add percentage points. Effective resistance uses its configured lower bound.
